readings: Matching postseason batting records to players on `player_id`, work out each player's average postseason doubles per record (ignoring missing values), grouped by player and batting hand (`player.bats`). Turn that into a relative index by dividing it by the overall average of these per-player averages. Then compare each player's index with the average index of players who have the same batting hand. List the 10 players whose index is furthest above their batting-hand average. Show the player id, batting hand, average doubles, index, and index minus the hand average, sorted by that difference from highest to lowest (missing values last), unrounded. Leave out players whose batting hand is empty or missing (NULL) entirely, including from the overall average. queries:
WITH p AS (
    SELECT pl.player_id, pl.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player pl ON bp.player_id = pl.player_id
    WHERE pl.bats IS NOT NULL AND pl.bats <> ''
    GROUP BY pl.player_id
),
o AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM p
),
i AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, p.avg_doubles, p.avg_doubles / o.overall_avg AS idx
    FROM p CROSS JOIN o
),
h AS (
    SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_avg FROM i GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT i.player_id, i.bats, i.avg_doubles, i.idx AS index_value, i.idx - h.hand_avg AS diff_from_hand_avg
FROM i JOIN h ON i.bats = h.bats
ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg IS NULL, diff_from_hand_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_player AS (
    SELECT p.player_id AS player_id,
           p.bats AS bats,
           AVG(b."double") AS avg_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason b
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM per_player
),
indexed AS (
    SELECT pp.player_id,
           pp.bats,
           pp.avg_doubles,
           pp.avg_doubles / o.overall_avg AS idx
    FROM per_player pp
    CROSS JOIN overall o
),
hand_avg AS (
    SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_idx_avg
    FROM indexed
    GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT i.player_id,
       i.bats,
       i.avg_doubles,
       i.idx AS index_value,
       i.idx - h.hand_idx_avg AS diff_from_hand_avg
FROM indexed i
JOIN hand_avg h ON h.bats = i.bats
ORDER BY (i.idx - h.hand_idx_avg) IS NULL, diff_from_hand_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH rec AS (
    SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, bp.double
    FROM batting_postseason bp
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> ''
),
per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats, AVG(double) AS avg_doubles
    FROM rec
    GROUP BY player_id, bats
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(double) AS overall_avg FROM rec
),
idx AS (
    SELECT pp.player_id, pp.bats, pp.avg_doubles,
           pp.avg_doubles / o.overall_avg AS idx
    FROM per_player pp, overall o
),
hand_avg AS (
    SELECT bats, AVG(idx) AS hand_idx FROM idx GROUP BY bats
)
SELECT i.player_id, i.bats, i.avg_doubles, i.idx, i.idx - h.hand_idx AS diff
FROM idx i
JOIN hand_avg h ON h.bats = i.bats
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

    GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
),
overall AS (

indexed AS (

           pp.avg_doubles / o.overall_avg AS idx

),
hand_avg AS (

SELECT i.player_id, i.bats, i.avg_doubles, i.idx AS index_value,

FROM indexed i
JOIN hand_avg h ON i.bats = h.bats
ORDER BY diff_from_hand_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
